title: Wordsworth's Idea of Childhood
content: Poets and philosophers have imagined childhood as an awakening from the sleep before life, or the sleep between lives.Companions, wasauctioned at Heritage for $21,250.00 onNov. 4, 2025]Some see it as a transitional phase between the sleep of non-existence and the waking sleep of modern life.I love the way William Wordsworth put it:"Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting:The Soul that rises with us, our life’s Star,Hath had elsewhere its setting,And cometh from afar.”Read the rest onSubstack.
